basic_info.description: Luxury Live Auction! Bidding to start from INCREDIBLE price of $2,250,000! That's less than $650/sq ft for prime San Francisco real estate. 2 VACANT single family homes, each with a garage, on a sunny corner lot. Trophy property. Rare legacy compound. Turnkey move-in or multiple development scenarios. Quiet, sunny. Easy stroll to Dolores Pk, Castro Village, Corona Hts, MUNI, more. 171 CASELLI is a vacant 2-level, 4 BR, 2 BA deco era home with parking & sunny walkout garden. REMODELED, grand scale, rich character, sunshine galore. LR has curved ceiling, arched windows all around, gas fireplace. FDR fits a dozen friends at table. Remodeled kitchen w/ counter seating. Oversized breakfast room. 2 BRs, deco BA with separate shower / tub on main level. 2 BRs, 2 BAs lower level. Luxury primary BR downstairs has seating area, en suite BA, 2 large closets. Interior access to garage. Laundry rm. Solar energy. 20 YUKON is a VACANT 2-story free-standing 1BR 1BA house on same lot. It has its own garage and street entry. Plus downtown views! Hardwoods. FP. Eat-in kitchen. Laundry. Lots of storage. If this sounds too good to be true, then seeing is believing!
